svg.aria-label: Eight Pro particle wallpaper styles in Terse — Cinematic, Aurora Silk, Starfall, Ink Wash, Neon Cyber, Gravity Vortex, Fireworks and Still Water — each forming its letter with its own particle motion.
svg.title: Terse wallpaper — eight Pro particle styles
svg.desc: Each style changes four things: the tint palette, the choreography of the surrounding field, and how text gathers and scatters. The letters here are made of particles, flying in the way each style actually flies text in.
